title: AI pothole detection automates road repair alerts in India #shorts #ai #roadrepair
description: This approach leverages AI and real-time data collection to improve urban infrastructure efficiently, reducing the burden on citizens while increasing accountability and speed in road repairs. If widely adopted, such technology could significantly enhance road safety and quality across India by systematically reporting and addressing potholes. The project exemplifies a practical, scalable application of AI for public good, showcasing how technology can transform community-driven civic engagement and infrastructural management. #AIforPublicGood #IndianInnovation #BangaloreDeveloper #SmartCityTech #PotholeDetection #UrbanInfrastructure #AIDashcam #RoadMaintenance #CivicTech #AutomatedReporting #AIinIndia #SmartRoads #TechForGood #InfrastructureAutomation #AIandUrbanPlanning
